_notes: Built from a live TSW7 session via `tsw-cli discover` + `tsw-cli get`, not guessed. Real notch counts (CombinedPowerBrakeHandle=9, Reverser=4) came from that loco's own Function.GetNotchCount. Class 333 is a British EMU with a single combined power/brake handle -- there's no separate throttle/brake on this unit, so those two stay unmapped here on purpose. No PZB/SIFA/LZB or ETCS either (British, not German-fitted, no ETCS on this route/stock combo). A few controls this loco genuinely has weren't mapped: TE_Down/TE_Program/BE_Down/BE_Program (traction/brake effort programming, no matching logical name yet), CouplerLock_F, PushButton, and the various S1/S2/S3 keypad + GSM-R radio panel buttons (a whole telephone/radio panel -- out of scope for the current control vocabulary).
